name: Nebraska Suicide Mortality Review Reporting Application
description: Application supporting the Nebraska Suicide Mortality Review process: integrates and reconciles successive Nebraska Violent Death Reporting System (NEVDRS) exports, detects and tracks record-level changes between exports, supports structured case annotation, and generates both individual case reports and the annual report to the Legislature.

name: NSWERS Data Explorer & Pipeline Visualization
description: Internal application for the Nebraska Statewide Workforce and Educational Reporting System data warehouse: located which tables held which variables, retrieved definitions, and traced data lineage back to the queries and source tables each variable depended on. Improved pipeline transparency, made problems easier to pinpoint, and shortened onboarding for the team.

name: NSWERS Synthetic Data Pipeline
description: Pipeline for generating privacy-preserving synthetic versions of large-scale, longitudinal administrative data from the Nebraska Statewide Workforce and Educational Reporting System, built on tidysynthesis, with utility and disclosure-risk evaluation using syntheval.

name: Recode Studio
description: Dataset-agnostic R/Shiny app for cleaning messy string variables without hand-writing R: browse values, flag likely typos via spellcheck, build and preview recode rules, and export both a reusable rule set and runnable R code.

name: Table Explorer
description: Interactive tool for discovering and visualizing primary/foreign-key relationships across tabular data: multi-signal key inference with confidence scoring, interactive entity-relationship diagrams, and exportable reports across many file and database formats (with a Python/Streamlit port).
